classification.difficultyReason: Differentiate a supplied cubic, classify its stationary points, compare endpoint values and interpret the global maximum using the stated units.

content.prompt:
Wobbly Skateboards looked at their sales in relation to their advertising budget. They found that the relationship between sales, $f(x)$, and thousands of dollars spent on advertising, $x$, was given by
$$f(x)=\frac{x^3}{3}-\frac{45x^2}{2}+450x,\qquad 10\leq x\leq40.$$

children.label: a
children.prompt: What number of advertising dollars can be expected to maximise number of sales?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}f'(x)&=x^2-45x+450\\0&=x^2-45x+450\\0&=(x-15)(x-30)\\x&=15\text{ or }30.\end{aligned}$$
$$\begin{aligned}f''(x)&=2x-45\\f''(15)&=-15<0\\f''(30)&=15>0.\end{aligned}$$
Thus $x=15$ is a local maximum and $x=30$ is a local minimum.
$$\begin{aligned}f(15)&=1125-5062.5+6750=\frac{5625}{2}\\f(30)&=9000-20250+13500=2250\\f(10)&=\frac{1000}{3}-2250+4500=\frac{7750}{3}\\f(40)&=\frac{64000}{3}-36000+18000=\frac{10000}{3}.\end{aligned}$$
Comparing the stationary-point and endpoint values, the global maximum occurs at $x=40$. Since $x$ is measured in thousands of dollars, the advertising expenditure is $\$40\,000$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: What sales can be expected for that amount of advertising? Give your answer to 2 decimal places.
